assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A canonical-token-versus-code audit that identifies stale copies, unused tokens, repeated raw values, and a CI prevention check.
assessments.rationale: It provides visual-design rules and warns against arbitrary values, but it does not compare a supplied canonical token file with theme and component sources or produce the requested drift categories and CI guard.
assessments.source_anchor: Use a constrained spacing scale, not arbitrary values.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A design-token drift audit against the canonical file covering stale copies, hardcoded values, unused tokens, repeated untokenized values, and CI prevention.
assessments.rationale: This is a broad interface-quality review and explicitly routes system-level token governance elsewhere; it does not provide the requested canonical-token reconciliation audit.

It directly compares canonical tokens with downstream definitions and consumption sites, reports stale copies, hardcoded values, orphan tokens, and repeated untokenized values, defers reconciliation pending approval, and offers a CI-failing guard.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A canonical-token-versus-theme/component drift audit with the four requested finding categories and a CI prevention check.
assessments.rationale: Its PR-focused review passes can identify general design issues, but it neither establishes a canonical token source nor audits token drift or supplies the requested CI guard.
assessments.source_anchor: Run a systematic multi-pass code review

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Inspection and report-only comparison of the supplied canonical token file with web theme and component styles, including a CI prevention check.
assessments.rationale: It imports code tokens into Figma and then applies updates; it does not audit web theme/component consumption for the requested drift categories and conflicts with the report-before-changes constraint.
assessments.source_anchor: Push design tokens from code INTO Figma as variables

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A canonical-token drift audit of existing web theme and component styles with stale-copy, hardcode, unused-token, repeated-value findings and CI prevention.
assessments.rationale: It routes design-artifact generation rather than inspecting an existing token file and web codebase for drift or producing a report-only CI proposal.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A design-token drift audit comparing the canonical token file with web theme and component styles and proposing CI prevention.
assessments.rationale: It is a gene-set enrichment analysis workflow and has no capability for design-token or web-style auditing.
assessments.source_anchor: Run GSEA on a ranked gene list

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Inspection of web theme and component styles against the supplied canonical token file, with drift findings and a CI prevention check.
assessments.rationale: It exports Figma variables into token formats, but it does not inspect code consumption or report stale copies, hardcodes, unused tokens, repeated values, and CI prevention.
